text_blocks.snippet: Pregnant women are at an increased risk of severe illness from COVID-19 compared to those who are not pregnant. However, most pregnant women who contract COVID-19 experience mild symptoms and recover fully. Common symptoms include fever, cough, and fatigue. Severe symptoms requiring emergency medical attention include trouble breathing and chest pain.
